findings.finding: The interrupted-migration resolve runner start was outside the unconditional post-outcome quiesce envelope, so timeout/nonzero could leave it running before the repair ledger read or a later public database-status read.
findings.required_remediation: After the resolve runner start outcome, unconditionally quiesce both sealed runners before the repair ledger read and only then reconcile or rethrow the start failure. Inventory all production prepared-runner start sites.
